rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for praising someone or something very highly and lavishly.

example.english: The customers heap praise on our dishes after eating and say they will definitely come again.
example.traditional: 客人食完之後大讚我哋啲菜，仲話一定會再嚟。
example.jyutping: haak3 jan4 sik6 jyun4 zi1 hau6 daai6 zaan3 ngo5 dei6 di1 coi3 zung6 waa6 jat1 ding6 wui5 zoi3 lai4

rows.note: Use this for a physical pile or mass of things such as earth or stones.

example.english: There’s a heap of sand and stones by the entrance, so be careful walking past.
example.traditional: 門口有堆沙石，行過小心啲。
example.jyutping: mun4 hau2 jau5 deoi1 saa1 sek6 haang4 gwo3 siu2 sam1 di1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a large amount or a lot of things.

example.english: I still have a heap of documents to read.
example.traditional: 我仲有一大堆文件未睇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 jau5 jat1 daai6 deoi1 man4 gin6 mei6 tai2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a dilapidated, junky car rather than an ordinary pile or large quantity.

example.english: His heap of a car keeps stalling halfway there.
example.traditional: 佢嗰架爛車成日喺半路死火。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go2 gaa3 laan6 ce1 seng4 jat6 hai2 bun3 lou6 sei2 fo2
